title: Median
text: Median value of input, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Method of rounding operation; {Sort algorithm} sets the sort method Quick, {Find the median value over} sets the dimension over which the median is computed Each, {Dimension} sets the custom dimension, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Product output}, {Accumulator}, {Output}, {Output Minimum} sets the minimum output value, {Output Maximum} sets the maximum output value and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Data input vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Median value along specified dimension vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Sort algorithm
params.values: Sort method Quick sort (default) | Insertion sort

params.name: Find the median value over
params.values: Dimension over which the median is computed Each column (default) | Entire input | Each row | Specified dimension

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Method of rounding operation Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Product output
params.values: Product output data type Inherit: Same as input (default) | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Accumulator data type Inherit: Same as product output (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: Output data type Inherit: Same as accumulator (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
